company.description:
Clutter is a provider of on-demand storage and moving services used to help customers store their physical belongings. The company aims to consistently provide hassle-free and affordable services by investing in exceptional people, smart technology, and pristine spaces.

Clutter was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Culver City, California.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,114,791 to $600,000,000, a 73.94x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
